newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 6.864 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 6.864 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 91-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.864 percent versus 6.49 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 175-day treasury bills was 7.091 percent versus 6.745 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 399-day treasury bills was 7.37 percent versus 7.159 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
